example.title: House, 302 West Kansas St. (Dougherty-Prospect Heights Historic District)

brief: Two-and-a-half-storey red-brick house of the transitional Queen Anne / foursquare kind: a hipped roof with steep cream-sided gables on the front and sides (small attic windows), a wide boxed cornice, stone lintels and sills, a canted bay on the side. A hip-roofed front porch on paired round white columns with a white spindle rail, concrete steps with an iron rail. Corner lot with a big lawn, foundation shrubs and a red frame garage behind.
